judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus a 2x crop of the vendor region; strict per-requirement pass/fail. Self-judged: the judging model is the artifact's own model.

requirements.text: Create a main structure for a wooden fruit stall, including a counter.
requirements.note: wooden stall with plank counter and crate base

requirements.text: Add a red and white striped canopy over the stall, supported by two vertical wooden posts.
requirements.note: red/cream striped canopy on two vertical brown posts

requirements.text: Display exactly four different, recognizable fruits.
requirements.note: six kinds: apples, oranges, grapes, yellow lemons, bananas, watermelons

requirements.text: First fruit: A pile of red apples in a wicker basket on the left side of the counter.
requirements.note: red apples in a woven-texture basket on the left of the counter

requirements.text: Second fruit: A bunch of yellow bananas placed next to the apples.
requirements.note: bananas rest on the counter at the right end, next to the yellow-fruit basket, not the apples

requirements.text: Third fruit: A pile of oranges in another wicker basket on the right side of the counter.
requirements.note: oranges occupy the middle wicker basket; the right basket holds yellow fruit

requirements.text: Fourth fruit: A single, large slice of watermelon resting directly on the counter in the center.
requirements.note: watermelon half and slices sit on the ground in front of the stall, not on the counter

requirements.text: Include a character representing the stall vendor, a smiling man with a mustache, positioned behind the counter and between the baskets.
requirements.note: vendor's face is fully buried behind the apple crate (crop shows only the straw hat and a grip arm); no smile or mustache visible, and he is behind the left basket, not between baskets

requirements.text: Add a small, hanging chalkboard sign from the canopy that reads 'Fresh Fruit'.
requirements.note: chalkboard is nailed to the counter front at crate height, not hung from the canopy, and its text is partly occluded by the watermelon

requirements.text: Depict a cobblestone ground surface in front of the stall.
requirements.note: flat tan ground with only shadow ellipses, no cobbles

requirements.text: Include the silhouette of another market stall in the background to suggest a larger market setting.
requirements.note: flat-painted teal-striped neighbor stall on the left reads as another market stall in the background
